TTA worst for cee210. In our time, she didn't take class for 2 weeks and also, in every class 30 to 40 mins late.

And those who say better for learning, ask them what she actually taught. 60% of the stuff I learnt during A level & 40% of the stuff my MAT250 faculty taught. Mechanics er ashol cherah dekhai nai jah learning best best bolah.
And also, when you are done with all quizzes and mid, then she will show the marks. So, you won't get a chance to secure your grade. So, you yourself need to be somewhat alert.
If mid & final her marking be like 0,10 or 25 out of 25.
For quiz ---> 0 or 10 or very rarely 5 out of 10
If 20 marks ---> 0 or 20
And none of them is 25 marks. She will make 5-7 marks math 25.
If you are an Edexcel English medium student, you will understand that she does not give any Method mark, Follow Through mark, Error Carried Forward mark, Benefit of Doubt mark, etc. Direct Correct Answer.
She'll be like
1. Your whole math was right, but you made a mistake with unit conversion and hence, your value was wrong (0 marks)
2. Your whole process was right, but just because you input or missed a value in your calculator, your final result came out wrong (0 marks)
3. Your whole process was right, but your component value was opposite, and hence, values went wrong (0 marks)
4. Out of 5 tension forces, you only found 4 tensions (0 marks)
5. Your whole math and even answer was correct, but you didn't draw a free body diagram, which the question specifically didn't mention to do so (0 marks)
6. For moment calculation, better to take anticlockwise as positive because if you take clockwise as positive, she would not understand and will say calculation mistake. I luckily got marks because, at the end, I mentioned ACW; otherwise, for getting a negative value (0 marks)
